assumptions.description: All furniture sizes, materials, people, lighting and positions are proposed, not surveyed. Original ERP geometry and assumptions remain unchanged.

Far end means the east end of Jeu principal, x1710–1920. The house has a115cm raised play deck,252cm overall height and no bed. Stairs/slide, guarding and headroom require specialist design before fabrication; displayed children are scale figures.

A single-wall50cm-deep counter on the east side of RDC avoids a central island. Compact espresso equipment, water, drainage, power, extraction and service operation are provisional. No downstairs seating.
Parent seating is upstairs in the same room as play. People illustrate atmosphere, not authorised capacity, staffing or supervision coverage.
The playhouse upper deck is visual only; the walking simulation stays on existing building floors. Furniture collision is included; scale figures are non-blocking.
